Chapter 193 - 193 Line Up; This Is Mine!

Chapter 193 - 193 Line Up; This Is Mine!

193 Line Up; This Is Mine!

Ding!

The elevator stopped steadily on the fourth floor.

It had to be said that KM Mall was indeed a famous mall in Jiangbei.

The luxurious and trendy decorations, coupled with the presence of many big brands, attracted many people to stroll around.

Walking out of the elevator, one could see the crowd coming and going, and one could hear the sound of laughter.

When shopping in the KM mall, one would feel as though one’s entire person had been elevated.

Lin Fan and the others walked and looked around. Not long after, they arrived at the Gucci store.

Du Yujia’s eyes lit up as she looked at the high-end and fashionable decorations of the Gucci store. She could not wait to walk in.

“Welcome to Gucci!” The female sales assistant standing at the door smiled.

Women seemed to be born with no resistance against bags.

Du Yujia and Tang Jiao looked at the gorgeous Gucci bags with their mouths wide open.

The female salesperson was already used to seeing this expression. She continued, “May I help you?”

Du Yujia finally reacted and said, “I want to buy a bag.”

“Are you using it yourself? Is there a style requirement?” the saleswoman said.

“Yes, it’s for me! Moreover, I’ve already seen the bags on the internet!” As Du Yujia spoke, she took out her phone and pulled out a photo of a bag from her photo album.

It had to be said that the female sales assistant’s professional knowledge was very solid.

With just a glance, she could tell the model of the bag and the inventory.

“This is the latest KP bag, but we don’t have it in stock yet…” the saleswoman said apologetically.

“What? You don’t?” Du Yujia said in disappointment.

“Yujia, is there anything else you like?” Tang Jiao asked.

“I’ve been looking at this bag for a long time. I really like it,” Du Yujia said.

At this moment, Lin Fan happened to see the photo of the bag on Du Yujia’s phone. He was slightly stunned.

This bag?

One had to know…

When Lin Fan obtained 5% of Gucci’s shares, the CEO sent a bunch of Gucci clothes and bags to Coiling Dragon Villa.

Even though Lin Fan did not check the clothes and bags, he had the scanning ability. With just a glance, he remembered everything.

One of the items was the bag shown in Du Yujia’s photo!

Lin Fan sighed in his heart, ‘If I had known that Du Yujia wanted to buy this bag, I would have taken her to Coiling Dragon Villa. I wasted a trip here.’

“I know where to find this bag,” Lin Fan said.

“Really?” Du Yujia said excitedly.

She had long planned to buy her favorite bag after her finals.

Therefore, whenever she had free time, she would look through the information and photos of many bags on the internet.

In the end, she chose the Gucci KP bag.

However, the specialty store did not sell it… Du Yujia could not help but feel disappointed.

However, now, Lin Fan said that he knew where to find it. This made Du Yujia feel like she had seen the light at the end of the tunnel.

Lin Fan nodded. “Yes, I’ll bring you there.”

“Alright!” Du Yujia said happily.

Then, Lin Fan, Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao returned to the parking lot.

Lin Fan stepped on the accelerator and drove out.

When they arrived at the exit, Yuan Hong was waiting in front with a large group of men and women in suits and leather shoes. They even wore their name tags that stated their roles—director, deputy general manager, and so on.

When they saw Lin Fan’s car, they immediately stood in two rows like soldiers waiting for a general to inspect them.

“Goodbye, Mr. Lin!”

Their voices were uniform and very imposing.

This was a send-off arranged by Yuan Hong.

In his opinion, Boss Lin Fan had finally come to KM Mall. Although he could not give them any guidance, they had to show that they valued his presence.

Du Yujia, Tang Jiao, and Lin Xiaoyao were stunned.

After the Mercedes-Benz G-Class left KM mall, the three of them slowly came back to their senses.

Lin Xiaoyao asked, “Brother, those people are… The general manager and director of KM Mall?”

Lin Fan had also seen the name tags on those people. He nodded and said, “Yes, they are.”

“Then… Why did they do that for you? They lined up just to send you off,” Lin Xiaoyao continued to ask.

Du Yujia and Tang Jiao pricked up their ears.

Obviously, they were also very curious about this question.

Lin Fan said casually, “Oh, because I’m the owner of KM Mall.”

Silence!

The entire car suddenly fell silent!

The owner of KM Mall?

One had to know that KM Mall was located in the heart of Jiangbei City, where every inch of land was worth an inch of gold!

Such a huge building with such luxurious decorations and so many big brands in it…

How much money did it cost?

Tens of millions?

A few hundred million?

Even though Lin Xiaoyao knew that her brother was very impressive and was even the largest shareholder of Yinshan Mall, she was still shocked.

Lin Fan did not care about it that much. He drove the Mercedes-Benz and went straight to the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex.

At this moment, Lin Xiaoyao and the others finally recovered from their shock.

They looked at the beautiful environment in the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex, and their eyes seemed to glow.

“These houses are like castles in fairy tales,” Tang Jiao praised.

“Look… There are several sports cars over there!” Du Yujia exclaimed, “Oh my God! Is that a helicopter?”

Lin Xiaoyao exclaimed and asked, “Brother, aren’t you bringing us to buy a Gucci bag? This seems to be someone’s home.”

Lin Fan did not answer immediately. Instead, he pressed his index finger on the passcode lock.

Beep!

The door opened.

The next moment, they saw that the house was filled with Gucci clothes and bags.

Their mouths immediately turned into an ‘O’ shape.

Initially, Lin Fan was living in this villa.

However, after the logistics company shipped Gucci’s clothes and bags to this villa, he moved to another villa.

As for these clothes and bags, they were no longer cared for.

Lin Fan saw that they were all stunned and did not move at all.

He could not help but walk in first. From the pile of clothes and bags, he took out the Gucci KP bag that Du Yujia wanted.

Lin Fan smiled. “Lil Yao, you said something wrong. This isn’t someone else’s home. It’s mine.”

His voice was like a stone thrown into a calm lake, immediately setting off ripples.

“Brother, you mean… Is this villa yours?” Lin Xiaoyao asked in disbelief.

“Yes, it is.” Lin Fan nodded.

“Then… these Gucci clothes and bags…” Lin Xiaoyao continued to ask.

“They’re mine too,” Lin Fan said matter-of-factly.
